cases.title: Panel: Show me again explains the change already made with a frame, and makes no second demonstration

rubric.reason: Turn 5 runs preview_frame and makes no change. It explains only the earlier change, 'Tab's pivot moved to the middle of its left edge, and the layer didn't move', with no numbers or field names, and ends by handing Door back: 'say done when its pivot is on the middle of its left edge.'

Every name and time the mentor uses (Door, Tab, Anchor Point, Position, 0 s, the middle of its left edge, pivots at their centers) appears in the snapshot, preview_frame or anchor_demo results. Turn 4's 'position read the same' follows from the identical layer_bounds before and after.

Each turn moves one idea and ends on something to do. Turn 1 asks the intent question and gives the Door proposal. Turn 2 ends on 'press A, then Shift+P' with no slide sentence. Turn 3 asks for Tab to be selected. Turns 4 and 5 report the one demo change and end on 'say done' for Door.

In Turn 5 preview_frame ran and nothing was changed; the mentor explained the one change already made ('Tab's pivot is still at the middle of its left edge, and Tab is in the same place it was before I moved the pivot') with no values or field names and no second demo, then handed back 'Now Door's yours: say done when its pivot is on the left edge.' Its note that the frame came out blank is not grounds to fail.

Every name the mentor used (Door, Tab, Anchor Point, Position, center, the middle of the left edge) is backed by tool output: place_now shows both at center, places shows middle-left, and Tab's identical layer_bounds before and after anchor_demo support 'Tab didn't move'.

Each turn moves one idea and ends on an action or a choice: the opening ends on the intent question plus the Door fallback offer, Turn 2 ends on 'press A, then Shift+P', Turns 3 and 4 hand over the next step, and Turn 5 is three short sentences ending on Door's pending step.

In Turn 5 the mentor ran preview_frame, explained only the change already made ("Tab's pivot moved to the middle of its left edge, and the layer itself stayed where it was") with no values or field names, made no change and no second demo, and handed Door back in one sentence.

Every name and time used (Door, Tab, Anchor Point, Position, middle of the left edge, pivots at their centers, Tab's unchanged edges) matches the snapshot, anchor_demo and preview_frame results, including the identical layer_bounds before and after.

Each turn moves one idea and ends on an action: Turn 1 ends on the Door proposal, Turn 2 on the A-then-Shift+P ask, Turn 3 on selecting Tab, and Turns 4 and 5 report the demo and then hand back "say done when its pivot is on the middle of its left edge".
